payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is her jacket fully closed?
node.criteria: Compare visible corresponding portions of the jacket’s front closure in SOURCE and EDITED. Full achievement requires the front panels to meet along the closure with no visible opening. Partial achievement requires visible evidence that the panels have moved together along some portion of the closure while an opening remains. Do not count a changed pose, drape, or panel movement by itself as closure progress. If pose, occlusion, or viewpoint prevents a reliable comparison of the closure, treat fulfillment as unobservable rather than inferring progress or no progress.
node.binding: Compare the jacket on the woman in SOURCE with the jacket on the woman in EDITED; the requested endpoint is a fully closed jacket. Assess corresponding visible closure cues, not pose or garment movement alone; if the closure cannot be reliably compared, leave fulfillment unresolved.
node.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
node.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
node.zero_when: Reliable visual comparison shows no movement of the front panels toward meeting along the closure; do not assign zero solely because the jacket remains open if the relevant closure is obscured or cannot be compared reliably.
node.half_when: Visible corresponding closure cues show that the front panels have moved together along part of the closure, but a visible opening remains; pose or drape change alone is not partial fulfillment.
node.full_when: The front panels meet along the visible closure with no visible opening remaining; if the closure is not sufficiently visible to establish this, fulfillment is unresolved rather than full.

node_traces.evidence: The jacket remains visibly open in EDITED, with the front panels separated. Comparing the visible front in SOURCE and EDITED shows no reliable evidence that the panels moved together along any part of the closure; the changed pose and drape do not count as closure progress. The requested fully closed endpoint is not achieved.
